statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let z := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.sqrt X / 2; let R := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ z X ≤ (p+2).minFac)); let T := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ (p+2).Prime)); let Q := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ (Nat.sqrt (p+2)).Prime ∧ p+2=(Nat.sqrt (p+2))^2)); let S := fun (X : ℕ) => @Finset.filter ℕ (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ∃ r s : ℕ, r.Prime ∧ s.Prime ∧ r < s ∧ Nat.sqrt X/2 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ Nat.sqrt (2*X+2) ∧ p+2=r*s) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (w X); let L := fun (p : ℕ) => Real.log p * Real.log (p+2); ∀ (X : ℕ) (M E F : ℝ), 4096 ≤ X → M ≤ (R X).sum L → (Q X).sum L ≤ E → (S X).sum L ≤ F → M-E-F ≤ (T X).sum L

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0069 · 由同一短窗的粗筛下界与两项污染预算提取真素数质量
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0069 · Extract prime-pair mass from the rough count and both loss bounds in the same window

brief.zh: 用 TP-0067 把粗筛和逐项覆盖到真素数、平方和两个不同素数。用 TP-0063、0068 的量纲同为对数权乘积。若 M−E−F>0，同一 X 有一对。用于 TP-0052R，仍需实际粗筛下界。
brief.en: Use TP-0067 to cover each rough survivor by a prime, a square or two distinct primes. TP-0063 and TP-0068 give bounds with the same log-product weights. A positive remainder supplies a pair at that X. TP-0052R still needs a lower bound on the actual rough count.
